one_upload_contract: One outer tar archive contains code, MIRACL fixture bodies, exact control records, a docker-save archive, an exact Hugging Face snapshot cache, and offline run/result wrappers. The KT host supplies only NVIDIA driver, Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, H200 access, and disk capacity.

outcome_contract.complete_and_audited: An audited 110K taxonomy artifact plus 20K/50K filter projections and result evidence are obtained. This is not a taxonomy A/B result.
outcome_contract.partial_or_failed: Only diagnostic records, raw-response hashes where available, receipt status, and audit failure evidence are obtained. No artifact success may be claimed.

required_outer_entries.content: clean generator source, validators, offline run/audit/projection/result wrappers, and source manifest

required_outer_entries.status: must be a real approved plan; no placeholder is permitted
must be issued by the actual approver after the exact plan exists
must match the final corrected runner source bytes
docker-save archive must be produced from the digest-pinned local image and recorded after creation
exact cache file manifest and its byte total are created only after the offline cache is acquired; tokens, refs to mutable branches, and credentials are excluded

required_outer_entries.content: single-entrypoint offline wrapper, checksum verifier, docker-load/import wrapper, and result collector

size_and_disk_contract.measurement_gate: Before release, record docker-save bytes/SHA-256, HF snapshot cache manifest bytes/SHA-256, final outer archive bytes/SHA-256, docker graph bytes after docker load, and free disk. Do not approve a capacity from registry/model-card display sizes alone.
size_and_disk_contract.outer_tar_bytes: Measured byte size of the final uncompressed tar after all required entries are present.
size_and_disk_contract.outer_tar_gz_bytes: Measured byte size of the final compressed upload archive; it is not the sum of compressed component estimates.
size_and_disk_contract.outer_uncompressed_formula: B_code + B_miracl_fixture + B_control + B_docker_save + B_hf_snapshot_cache + B_run_wrappers + B_manifests
size_and_disk_contract.peak_disk_formula_while_keeping_upload_a: B_outer_tar_gz + B_outer_uncompressed + B_docker_graph_after_load + B_docker_load_temporary + B_generation_outputs + B_result_tar + B_required_safety_reserve
